title: Library Shelf Builders
focus: Add hundreds, tens, and ones separately when no regrouping is needed.

quiz.context: The school library has 142 storybooks and receives 215 more storybooks; how many storybooks does it have altogether?
A librarian puts 231 books on one shelf and 146 books on another shelf; how many books are on the two shelves altogether?
Pupils collect 314 Malay books and 253 English books; how many books do they collect altogether?

title: Canteen Cup Crew
focus: Regroup ten ones as one ten when adding two numbers.

quiz.context: The canteen has 26 cups on a tray and adds 17 more cups; how many cups are on the tray now?
A canteen helper washes 38 cups before recess and 24 cups after recess; how many cups does the helper wash altogether?
There are 47 clean cups in a cupboard and 35 clean cups on a trolley; how many clean cups are there altogether?

title: Batik Colour Warehouse
focus: Regroup ten tens as one hundred when the tens column reaches ten or more.

quiz.context: A batik workshop has 150 blue beads and 280 red beads; how many beads does it have altogether?
Pupils print 260 leaf shapes and 370 flower shapes on batik cloth; how many shapes do they print altogether?
A workshop packs 360 wooden stamps in the morning and 450 wooden stamps in the afternoon; how many stamps does it pack altogether?

title: Festival Flag Factory
focus: Regroup from ones to tens and from tens to hundreds in the same addition.

quiz.context: Pupils make 186 flags on Monday and 247 flags on Tuesday; how many flags do they make altogether?
A school hangs 278 flags in the hall and 356 flags along the corridor; how many flags does it hang altogether?
A club prepares 367 small flags and 458 large flags; how many flags does it prepare altogether?

title: Bus Ticket Trail
focus: Count forward in tens while keeping the ones digit unchanged.

quiz.context: A bus station sells 126 tickets in the morning and 30 more tickets at noon; how many tickets does it sell altogether?
A ticket box holds 253 tickets and a worker adds 40 tickets; how many tickets are in the box now?
A bus company prints 378 tickets and then prints 50 more tickets; how many tickets does it print altogether?

title: Recycling Hundred Hunt
focus: Add whole hundreds by changing the hundreds digit and keeping tens and ones unchanged.

quiz.context: A class collects 137 bottles and another class collects 200 bottles; how many bottles do the classes collect altogether?
A recycling centre has 264 cans and receives 300 more cans; how many cans does it have now?
Pupils collect 381 sheets of paper in one week and 400 sheets in the next week; how many sheets do they collect altogether?

title: Kuih Tray Shortcuts
focus: Add a nearby multiple of ten and then adjust for the extra amount added.

quiz.context: A kuih stall has 34 pieces of kuih and adds 19 freshly made pieces; how many pieces of kuih does it have now?
A baker makes 57 pieces of kuih in the morning and 29 pieces in the afternoon; how many pieces does the baker make altogether?
A school fair sells 126 pieces of kuih before noon and 39 pieces after noon; how many pieces does it sell altogether?

title: School Garden Stepping Stones
focus: Split the second addend to reach the next hundred before adding the remaining amount.

quiz.context: Pupils plant 87 seedlings on Monday and 26 seedlings on Tuesday; how many seedlings do they plant altogether?
The school garden has 178 flowers and pupils plant 45 more flowers; how many flowers are in the garden now?
A gardening club collects 269 seeds and finds 54 more seeds; how many seeds does it collect altogether?

title: Bookshop Stock Check
focus: Subtract hundreds, tens, and ones separately when no regrouping is needed.

quiz.context: A bookshop has 476 exercise books and sells 234 of them; how many exercise books remain?
A school receives 685 pencils and gives 352 pencils to pupils; how many pencils remain?
A bookshop has 897 bookmarks and sells 465 of them; how many bookmarks remain?

title: Canteen Spoon Rescue
focus: Exchange one ten for ten ones when there are too few ones to subtract.

quiz.context: The canteen has 63 spoons and pupils take 28 spoons; how many spoons remain?
A helper places 82 forks on a trolley and takes 37 forks to the tables; how many forks remain on the trolley?
There are 95 plates in the canteen and 48 plates are used for lunch; how many plates remain unused?

title: Batik Roll Store
focus: Exchange one hundred for ten tens when there are too few tens to subtract.

quiz.context: A batik shop has 352 metres of ribbon and uses 180 metres; how many metres of ribbon remain?
A workshop has 475 wooden beads and uses 290 beads; how many beads remain?
Pupils draw 684 batik shapes and colour 390 of them; how many shapes remain to be coloured?

title: Zero Bridge Station
focus: Regroup through a zero in the tens column to subtract ones.

quiz.context: A bus station has 304 tickets and sells 156 of them; how many tickets remain?
A school has 502 stickers and gives away 187 stickers; how many stickers remain?
A library has 700 lending cards and uses 268 of them; how many lending cards remain unused?

title: Bus Ticket Countdown
focus: Count backward in tens while keeping the ones digit unchanged.

quiz.context: A bus station has 245 tickets and sells 30 tickets; how many tickets remain?
A ticket machine holds 376 tickets and prints out 40 tickets; how many tickets remain inside?
A bus company prepares 487 tickets and uses 50 tickets for a school trip; how many tickets remain?

title: Recycling Bale Drop
focus: Subtract whole hundreds by changing the hundreds digit and keeping tens and ones unchanged.

quiz.context: A recycling centre has 737 cans and sends 200 cans away; how many cans remain?
Pupils collect 864 bottles and deliver 300 bottles to a recycling centre; how many bottles remain to be delivered?
A club collects 981 sheets of paper and uses 400 sheets for crafts; how many sheets remain?

title: Pocket Money Shortcuts
focus: Subtract a nearby multiple of ten and then add back the extra amount subtracted.

quiz.context: Aina saves RM43 and spends RM19 on a storybook; how many ringgit does she have left?
Ravi has RM65 and spends RM29 on art supplies; how many ringgit does he have left?
Mei has RM84 and spends RM39 on a school bag; how many ringgit does she have left?

title: Reading Goal Ladder
focus: Find the difference by counting up from the smaller number to the larger number.

quiz.context: A reading challenge has a target of 100 pages and Sara has read 86 pages; how many more pages must she read to reach the target?
A school wants to collect 200 books and has collected 175 books; how many more books does it need?
A club wants to make 300 bookmarks and has made 267 bookmarks; how many more bookmarks must it make?

title: Paired Petal Workshop
focus: Use repeated addition to find totals in equal groups of two or three.

quiz.context: Each paper flower needs 2 leaves and pupils make 6 flowers; how many leaves do they need altogether?
Each batik motif has 3 petals and pupils draw 4 motifs; how many petals do they draw altogether?
Each craft kit has 3 coloured pencils and a teacher prepares 7 kits; how many coloured pencils are needed altogether?

title: Kuih Box Skip Count
focus: Skip-count in fives and tens to find the total in equal groups.

quiz.context: Each box holds 5 pieces of kuih and a baker fills 4 boxes; how many pieces of kuih are in the boxes altogether?
Each packet holds 10 stickers and a teacher buys 6 packets; how many stickers does the teacher buy altogether?
Each tray holds 5 cups and a helper fills 7 trays; how many cups are on the trays altogether?

title: Kuih Sharing Circle
focus: Share a total equally among two or five groups to find the amount in each group.

quiz.context: A baker shares 20 pieces of kuih equally between 2 plates; how many pieces are on each plate?
A teacher shares 35 pencils equally among 5 pupils; how many pencils does each pupil receive?
Pupils share 16 bookmarks equally between 2 reading groups; how many bookmarks does each group receive?

title: Ten Ticket Bundles
focus: Make groups of ten and count the groups to solve exact division.

quiz.context: A bus station ties 40 tickets into bundles of 10 tickets; how many bundles does it make?
A librarian packs 70 bookmarks into packets of 10 bookmarks; how many packets does the librarian make?
A batik workshop packs 110 beads into bags of 10 beads; how many bags does it fill?
